config.name: dataVolume.deleteOnVmDestroy
config.description: A boolean value indicating whether deleting attached data volumes when destroying a vm. If false, the data volume will be detached and be retained in primary storage

config.name: instanceOffering.setNullWhenDeleting
config.description: whether update instance offering column of VM inventory to NULL when the instance offering is deleted

config.name: deletionPolicy
config.description: the behavior of deleting a vm, options are [Direct, Delay, Never]. Direct: delete the vm from database and directly delete its root volume; Delay: change the vm's state to Destroyed in database; after the period controlled by 'expungePeriod' passes, delete the vm from database and delete it's root volume; Never: delete the vm from database but never delete its root volume

config.name: expungePeriod
config.description: the period before a destroyed vm being deleted from database and before its root volume being deleted from primary storage, in seconds

config.name: expungeInterval
config.description: the interval the expunging vm task runs, in seconds

config.name: cleanTraffic
config.description: switch for clean spoofing traffic from vm

config.name: multivNic.support
config.description: A boolean value indicating whether support to create more than one nics with a L3 network in the a VM. If false, there only no more than one nic can be created for a VM with a L3 Netowrk

config.name: spiceStreamingMode
config.description: config vm streaming mode when use spice

config.name: videoType
config.description: video type for VM. "virtio" supply basic video type. "vga" supply more high resolution for VM. "qxl" supply high performance when use SPICE protocal. "cirrus" mark as deprecated, reserved for compatibility. Options:[vga, cirrus, qxl, virtio]

config.name: soundType
config.description: sound type for VM. "ich6" supply basic sound typen for VM. Options:[ich6, ich9, ac97]

config.name: numa
config.description: whether to use numa structure

config.name: vmPortOff

config.name: pciePortNums
config.description: PCIe-root-port numbers of VM. On x86-64/q35, it determine the hot-pluggable pci device numbers.

config.name: deletion.gcInterval
config.description: update vm metadata interval

config.name: vm.metadata
config.description: save vm metadata

config.name: vm.metadata.ps.maxConcurrent
config.description: Max concurrent metadata writes per primary storage per MN. In dual-MN the actual global concurrency per PS = 2 × this value.

config.name: vm.metadata.global.maxConcurrent
config.description: Max concurrent VM metadata updates globally per MN. In dual-MN the actual global concurrency = 2 × this value.

config.name: vm.metadata.gc.initialDelaySec
config.description: Initial GC delay in seconds after API success. The first metadata update attempt happens after this delay.

config.name: vm.metadata.maxRetry
config.description: Max retry count before giving up metadata flush. After this many failed attempts with exponential backoff, the dirty row is deleted and will auto-retry on the next API that modifies this VM.

config.name: vm.metadata.dirty.pollIntervalSec
config.description: Dirty poller interval in seconds. The poller acts as a safety net to process dirty rows that were not handled by the immediate triggerFlush path (e.g., rows in backoff, orphaned rows after MN crash).

config.name: vm.metadata.dirty.batchSize
config.description: Max dirty rows to claim per poller cycle. Controls the batch size of CAS claim in each poller round.

config.name: vm.metadata.upgrade.refreshDelaySec
config.description: Delay in seconds before full refresh after upgrade, waiting for rolling upgrade to complete

config.name: vm.metadata.upgrade.refreshBatchSize
config.description: Upgrade full refresh SQL batch size

config.name: vm.metadata.nodeLeft.delaySec
config.description: Delay in seconds after nodeLeft before takeover, reduces zombie MN race condition

config.name: vm.metadata.staleRecovery.intervalSec
config.description: MetadataStaleRecoveryTask scan interval in seconds

config.name: vm.metadata.staleRecovery.batchSize
config.description: MetadataStaleRecoveryTask rows per scan batch

config.name: vm.metadata.staleRecovery.maxCycles
config.description: Max consecutive stale recovery cycles per VM before circuit-break

config.name: vm.metadata.pendingApi.timeoutMinutes
config.description: Pending API timeout cleanup threshold in minutes

config.name: vm.metadata.retry.baseDelaySeconds
config.description: Exponential backoff base delay in seconds

config.name: vm.metadata.retry.maxExponent
config.description: Exponential backoff max exponent

config.name: vm.metadata.init.batchSize
config.description: Batch size per round when enabling metadata (false to true init)

config.name: vm.metadata.init.batchDelaySec
config.description: Delay in seconds between init batches to prevent IO storm

config.name: vm.metadata.orphanCheck.intervalSec
config.description: Orphan metadata detection interval in seconds

config.name: vm.metadata.zombieClaim.thresholdMinutes
config.description: Zombie claim threshold in minutes: claimed dirty rows older than this are released

config.name: vm.metadata.staleClaim.thresholdMinutes
config.description: Stale claim threshold in minutes for background recovery task

config.name: vm.metadata.triggerFlush.staleMinutes
config.description: Inline stale claim takeover threshold in minutes for triggerFlushForVm hot path

config.name: vm.metadata.delete.maxRetry
config.description: Max retry count for deleteMetadata in ExpungeVmInstanceFlow

config.name: vm.metadata.delete.baseDelaySec
config.description: Base delay in seconds for deleteMetadata retry backoff

config.name: vm.metadata.lastRefreshVersion
config.description: Last completed upgrade refresh version, prevents duplicate triggers across MNs. Internal use only

config.name: vm.metadata.contentCheck.intervalSec
config.description: Metadata content drift detection interval in seconds (default 6h)

config.name: vm.metadata.contentCheck.batchSize
config.description: Batch size for metadata content drift detection keyset pagination

config.name: vm.metadata.storageOrphanCheck.intervalSec
config.description: Storage-level orphan metadata detection interval in seconds. Scans primary storages for metadata files whose VM no longer exists or has migrated away.
